# Brisk Quick Start

## Installation

To install Brisk, run the following command in your terminal:

```bash
brisk install
```

This command will download and install the Brisk tool on your system.

## Verification

After installation, verify that Brisk is properly configured by running the following command:

```bash
brisk status
```

This command will display the current status of your Brisk installation, including version information and available features.
